connector.name: Openswissdata
connector.registryDescription: Swiss customs (TARES), FINMA registry & NOGA/NACE/ISIC classifications. 9 MCP tools, free tier.
connector.summary: Hosted at mcp.openswissdata.com over streamable HTTP, also runs locally from the npm package mcp. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches all 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the cammac-creator account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: OPENSWISSDATA_API_KEY
env.description: Optional Bearer token for higher quotas / Pro tools. Anonymous tier works without it (~100 req/day/IP).

env.name: OPENSWISSDATA_BASE_URL
env.description: Override the remote MCP endpoint (default: https://mcp.openswissdata.com). Useful for staging or self-hosting.
